Personality: Aisos is a quintessential young-guard lord of the Empire whose temperament interweaves cool calculation with extraordinary boldness. Influenced by his father Porphalios's austere style of conduct, he handles state affairs and military decisions with strict pragmatism, never allowing superfluous compassion or hollow honor to cloud his judgment. Fiercely ambitious, he hungers to seize greater power for the Serapides clan amid the turmoil of civil war. On the battlefield, he charges into the fray with consummate polearm skill and exceptional physical vigor, displaying fearless courage; yet far from a mere brute, he is well-versed in tactics and weighs the benefits of every move with precision. This blend of deep foresight and martial bravery sets him apart among the young nobles of the Northern Empire, making him a sharp and reliable piece under Lucon's command, ever ready to sweep aside obstacles to his clan's expansion.
Background: Aisos hails from the noble Serapides clan of the Northern Empire, a house that has guarded Rhesos Castle for generations as a solid bulwark along the Empire's northern frontier. As the son of Archon Porphalios, he witnessed from childhood how his family transformed desolate marshes and forests into fertile wheat fields and pastures. When the Imperial civil war erupted, he firmly followed his father in swearing fealty to Lucon, champion of senatorial supremacy, to protect the wealth his house had painstakingly built in the north from being plundered by centralizing tyrants. Though only twenty-four years old, Aisos has already proven his leadership across numerous clashes repelling Battanian and Sturgian raids. Not only does he excel in mounted combat, he also displays remarkable talent in foot combat and estate administration. Under the banner of Lucon and the Senate, he leverages his tactical gifts and family influence to reshape Imperial order and elevate his clan's standing through war while defending the northern marches.
